content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 58 vacancies in total across 25 departments. The department-wise figures below add up to 58. 3 (three) posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments as per Government of India policy. One per cent each is reserved for persons with benchmark disabilities under clauses (a), (b) and (c), and one per cent for those under clauses (d) and (e): (a) blindness and low vision; (b) deaf and hard of hearing; (c) locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy; (d) autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (e) multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness, in the posts identified for each disability. The numbers of vacant posts are inclusive of backlog vacancies. Candidates from General and other categories will also be considered for adhoc appointment against vacant posts of a reserved category (marked with an asterisk *) if reserved category candidates are not available. In General Medicine 3 posts, in General Surgery 2 posts and in Obstetrics & Gynaecology 1 post will be considered for adhoc appointment against OBC posts. EWS posts are not carried forward or considered as backlog vacancy if unfilled. Other category candidates may be allowed provisionally to apply, and will be considered for the post as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Persons possessing a qualification included in Part II of the 3rd Schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in Section 13(B) of the Act. The notice mentions an experience certificate only "if applicable" and prints no minimum experience. The age limit is 45 years. Age is counted on the last date of submission of applications, 20.11.2026 up to 5:30 p.m., which the notice calls the crucial date for age, educational qualification and experience. Reservation and age relaxation are provided as per Govt. of India norms. For discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.qualification: Post graduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) in respective fields/subject after obtaining a medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of 3rd Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956; satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship after MBBS; registration with any State Medical Council/NMC.

rows.relaxation: Up to 5 (five) years, in respect of vacancies reserved for them
Up to 3 (three) years, in respect of vacancies reserved for them
As per Govt. of India norms

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 11 of Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.67700/- per month plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under the Central Govt. Rules in identical posts. Appropriate accommodation as per availability will be provided. No travelling allowance will be paid by the office for attending the interview. Contract term and tenure are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctors
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only as printed in the notice. Candidates satisfying the eligibility in all respects submit the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I, together with scanned copies of the self attested certificates listed below, to [email protected] . The last date of submission is 20.11.2026 up to 5:30 p.m. Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I. Scan the self attested certificates and one recent passport size photo listed under Documents Required. Email the proforma and scanned copies to [email protected] on or before 20.11.2026, 5:30 p.m. The Institute screens the submitted documents before the interview; only eligible candidates are allowed to appear. Watch the Institute's website for the interview date, which will be published there. Bring the original documents to the Institute at the time of interview. For queries, contact [email protected] or phone 0364-2538020 or 0364-2539-215/216. The interview date and venue are not given in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned copies, self attested, to be emailed with the Annexure-I proforma: One recent passport size photo Certificate of Date of Birth (10th certificate) Certificate of SC/ST/Latest OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) from the competent authority, if applicable MBBS passed certificate, MBBS marksheets, MBBS attempt certificate and MBBS internship completion certificate MCI/NMC eligibility certificate for candidates passing from foreign medical institutions Result of screening test for Indian nationals with foreign medical qualification, issued by the National Board of Examinations MD/MS/DNB passed certificate Medical Registration Certificate for MBBS/MD/MS/DNB NOC from the present employer (if employed) Experience certificate (if applicable) Residence certificate issued by competent authority, or Aadhar card or voter ID and Passport Character certificate

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident Doctor vacancies are there in NEIGRIHMS?
faq.answer: NEIGRIHMS has 58 Senior Resident Doctor vacancies across 25 departments, inclusive of backlog vacancies. General Medicine has the most posts with 7.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor posts?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of applications is 20 November 2026 (Friday), up to 5:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor?
faq.answer: A post graduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the respective field, after a medical qualification in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956, plus compulsory internship after MBBS and registration with a State Medical Council/NMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years, counted on 20.11.2026 up to 5:30 p.m. Relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layers) in vacancies reserved for them.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 11 of the Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.67700/- per month plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under Central Govt. Rules in identical posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor posts?
faq.answer: Email the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I with scanned self attested certificates to [email protected] by 20.11.2026, 5:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor?
faq.answer: Submitted documents are screened before the interview, and only eligible candidates are allowed to appear. The interview date will be published on the Institute's website.

faq.question: Q8. Are allowances paid on top of the Level 11 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states entry pay of Rs.67700/- per month plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under Central Govt. Rules in identical posts.

faq.question: Q9. Will travelling allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No travelling allowance will be paid by the office for attending the interview. Appropriate accommodation as per availability will be provided.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants employed under State or Central Govt. or PSU/Autonomous body must produce an NOC from the competent authority, or they will not be allowed to appear for interview.
